display.purpose: Large empty-state titles, hero section headers. Light weight 300 is intentional confidence.

headline.purpose: Page titles, modal headers, primary section headers.

title.purpose: Card titles, conversation names, list-item primary text.

body.purpose: Message content, paragraph copy, descriptions. Cap at 65-75ch for prose blocks.

label.purpose: The signature: status pills, timestamps, section sub-headers, AI provenance tags, kanban column titles. JetBrains Mono uppercase tracked 0.1em is non-negotiable.

shadows.name: card-hover-light
shadows.purpose: Hover lift in light mode, paired with translateY(-1px).

shadows.name: modal-light
shadows.purpose: Modals and sheets in light mode. Reserved for floating surfaces.

shadows.name: modal-dark
shadows.purpose: Modals and sheets in dark mode.

shadows.name: focus-halo-light

shadows.name: focus-halo-dark
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus state in dark mode.

shadows.name: coral-halo
shadows.purpose: Reserved for primary-CTA hover and active recording/call indicators. The product's alive shadow.

motion.name: ease-fast
motion.purpose: Quick state changes: button press, hover swap, focus ring appearance.

motion.name: ease-base
motion.purpose: Default transition curve. Near ease-out-expo. The system's heartbeat.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Gradient rose-to-pink primary action. Reserved for the dominant action on a screen (Send, Save, Create).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f43f5e 0%, #ec4899 100%); color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(244,63,94,0.30); cursor: pointer; transition: all 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e11d48 0%, #db2777 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(244,63,94,0.40); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(244,63,94,0.30); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(244,63,94,0.30), 0 0 0 5px rgba(244,63,94,0.15); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Coral outline. Secondary action paired with a primary gradient CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #f43f5e; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 18px; border: 2px solid #f43f5e; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(244,63,94,0.10); color: #e11d48; border-color: #e11d48; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,63,94,0.15); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-priority action. Toolbar buttons, dropdown items, dismissible inline actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #52525b; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f2f2f2; color: #0f0f0f; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default text field. 16px radius, hairline border, body type.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #0f0f0f; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 16px; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #f43f5e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,63,94,0.10); }

narrative.overview: Pulse is the operator's command surface — a dense, instrument-grade interface for someone running ten things at once, where coral is the single living signal underneath an otherwise quiet, decisive chrome. Inter handles structure; JetBrains Mono handles labels and metadata; rose (#f43f5e) handles the heartbeat. Everything else recedes. The system rejects the grey-on-grey enterprise messaging look (Slack, Teams), the tabbed-form CRM density (Salesforce, HubSpot), and the gradient-purple AI-startup template that signals AI made this. It also rejects the opposite reflex — soft pastel friendliness, oversized cards, decorative gradients on hero panels. Pulse is closer to Linear's precision and Raycast's economy than to anything in the messaging-app category. The warmth comes from coral plus tinted neutrals plus tight copy, not from rounded corners and pastel illustrations. Both themes are first-class. Light mode is #f8f8f8 paper with rgba(0,0,0,0.08) borders — daylight, alert, focused. Dark mode is #000000 true-black canvas with translucent rgba(255,255,255,0.03) surfaces — late-night, deep-work, glass-on-graphite. Neither is the default; the user picks the room.
keyCharacteristics: Coral-as-signal, never coral-as-decoration. The accent earns every appearance.
Tinted neutrals over true grey — even the black canvas (#000) sits next to translucent surfaces, never flat panels stacked on flat panels.
Inter for everything structural; JetBrains Mono for labels, timestamps, metadata, and tags. The mono label is the system's signature.
12px is the default radius. 8px is for chips and tight controls. 16-20px reserved for modals and sheets.
Motion uses cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) (a near-ease-out-expo) at 220ms — fast, decisive, no bounce.

rules.name: The Coral-As-Signal Rule
rules.body: Rose Pulse (#f43f5e) appears on ≤10% of any screen, reserved for: send/primary CTA, active state, unread, focus ring, urgent alerts. When everything is coral, nothing is. If a design has more than three coral elements visible at rest, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff anywhere in the product UI surfaces. Light mode uses #f8f8f8 / #0f0f0f; dark mode uses #000000 only as the deep canvas, with translucent surfaces (rgba(255,255,255,0.03) and up) carrying every component.

rules.name: The Status-Stays-Status Rule
rules.body: The eleven status colors do not leave the status vocabulary. They never become decorative accents, never replace coral on a CTA, never tint a hero. Their meaning is their job.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Every uppercase wide-tracked label uses JetBrains Mono, never Inter. The mono is what makes Pulse look like an instrument; using Inter for uppercase labels collapses it into Generic SaaS. Mono labels are always at least 0.05em tracked (typically 0.1em).

rules.name: The 65-Ch Rule
rules.body: Long-form prose (AI summaries, message bodies, knowledge-base content, decision notes) is capped at 65–75 characters per line. This is non-negotiable; AI-generated text in particular must inherit this constraint or it reads as a wall.

rules.name: The Light-Display Rule
rules.body: Display weights of 300 are intentional, not weak. Inter at 300 in 30-48px reads as quiet confidence. Don't fix them by bumping to 600; that's a pre-2020 reflex.

rules.name: The Translucency-Over-Tinting Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, surface depth comes from rgba(255,255,255,0.03) translucent layers, not from progressively-lighter opaque panels. Stacking opaque grey-#1A on grey-#222 on grey-#2A is a 2014 dark-mode reflex; Pulse stacks 3% white on 6% white on the true-black canvas, so the canvas stays felt at every layer.

rules.name: The 2px-Lift-Cap Rule
rules.body: No hover ever lifts an element more than 2px (typically 1px). Anything larger reads as theatrical. CTAs may add a coral halo on hover; they may not also rise 4px and grow.

rules.name: The Backdrop-Filter Discipline
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur(...) is reserved for modals, command palette, dropdown menus, and floating panels. It is never applied to a card on a list. Glass-everywhere is the absolute ban; glass-on-purpose is fine.

dos: Do keep coral on ≤10% of any screen — primary CTAs, active state, unread, focus, urgent alerts. The Coral-As-Signal Rule.
Do tint every neutral toward the brand hue. Light canvas is #f8f8f8, never #fff. Dark canvas is #000 only with translucent surfaces above — never opaque grey panels.
Do use JetBrains Mono uppercase tracked 0.1em for every label, timestamp, status, and section header. The mono is the signature.
Do cap prose at 65–75ch. AI summaries, message bodies, and knowledge-base content all inherit this.
Do use 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) as the default transition curve. It's the system's heartbeat.
Do test every screen in both light and dark before shipping. Both modes are first-class.
Do prefix every AI-generated artifact with a JetBrains Mono provenance tag (CLAUDE · SUMMARY, GEMINI · DRAFT). Make AI auditable.
Do stack translucent surfaces in dark mode (rgba(255,255,255,0.03) → 0.055 → 0.08) so the true-black canvas is always felt through the layers.
donts: Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left: 3px solid <color> on cards or list items as a status accent). This is an absolute ban under impeccable's design laws and an existing migration target in the codebase. Replace with: status pill at the top-right corner, full 1px colored border + matching tinted background, or leading status icon + label.
Don't use gradient text. background-clip: text over a gradient is decorative and never meaningful in this product. Use solid color and weight contrast for emphasis.
Don't use #000 text on light or #fff text on dark anywhere. Use #0f0f0f and #fafafa. The half-step matters.
Don't apply backdrop-filter: blur(...) to anything in a list. Reserve glass for modals, command palette, dropdowns, and floating panels.
Don't ship the hero-metric template (big number + small label + four equal stat cards in a row). It's the SaaS cliché — replace with sparklines, a chart, or a single sentence in body type.
Don't stack opaque grey panels in dark mode (Slack/Teams reflex). Stack translucent surfaces on the true-black canvas.

Don't use the gradient-purple AI-startup template — purple-to-pink hero gradients, sparkle icons next to every button, AI in 8 places. Pulse's AI is visible through provenance tags and quality, not through purple chrome.
Don't use Material Design defaults, shadcn-as-shipped, or Bootstrap shapes. If a component looks like it could be in any other product, it's wrong.
Don't nest cards. A card inside a card is always a structural mistake.
Don't lift hover states more than 2px. Anything larger reads as theatrical.
Don't use Inter for uppercase tracked labels. Always JetBrains Mono. Inter-uppercase reads as Generic SaaS; Mono-uppercase reads as instrument.
Don't use status colors (the eleven semantic hues) as decorative accents anywhere outside their status vocabulary. They're meaning, not palette.
Don't use em dashes inside the product UI. Commas, colons, periods, parentheses only.
Don't apologize in copy. No Oops!, no Something went wrong, sorry. Be specific about what broke and what to do next. Confidence is the brand.
